official_pins.role: University-published building names and navigation pin centers. Pins may be centers/entrances; not survey control.

osm.role: Community-traced footprints, roads, paths, landuse, sport areas and campus boundary; no claim of survey accuracy or exhaustive present-day coverage.
osm.share_alike_note: Retain OpenStreetMap attribution and comply with ODbL for any distributed derived database.

geometry.role: Local approximate meter projection; rigid axis orientation estimated by PCA of OSM main building polygon; no surveyed terrain elevations.
geometry.anchor: University official main-building pin at 35.142722,126.934734 maps to (0,8.5). Existing modeled facade y0.
geometry.precision_note: Decimal coordinates aid geometry processing; do not imply positional accuracy.

height_elevation.role: No measured terrain elevations obtained; height values null unless source tags explicitly contain height/levels. Any rendered massing/floor-derived height or terrain is an illustration and must be labeled estimated.

photo_reference.role: University photos and campus-map artwork are research references only, copyright retained by owner. Do not redistribute as original art or imply OSM license covers these.
